scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Tourism Promotion Assistance in lieu of Interest Subsidy
other_conditions: The unit must be a tourism project/unit or an expansion of an existing unit set up on or after 22 February 2021
Hotel units that commenced commercial operations between 7 January 2015 and 31 December 2020 are eligible if they could not apply under the 2015 scheme due to absence of a Bar in the Hotel
Units may belong to the private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector, or be companies/undertakings owned or managed by the State Government
The project must be supported by a detailed feasibility report prepared for the purpose
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, a Commercial Bank or a State Financial Institution
The unit must hold a Registration Certificate, a Date of Commencement Certificate and an Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited
benefits_summary: Assistance of 75% of SGST for a period of five years, provided in lieu of interest subsidy.
